'''Wilder Than a Cat in a Bathtub''' is the ninth episode of {{S|51}}.
==Story==
===Day 16===
===Day 17===
==Challenges==
<tabber>Reward=
'''Challenge:''' ''[[Losing Face|Heroes End]]''<br />The castaways will be divided into two teams of five via schoolyard pick. On Jeff's go, one person will get on a sled. The other four will push that sled down a track. They'll then lift the sled to allow the player to retrieve a key. They'll then head back down the track. They'll then lift the player up again to release a pile of sandbags. They'll then gather all your sandbags, and use the key to unlock a slingshot. It is in a race to fire sandbags at three targets. The first team to knock down all three targets wins reward.<br />'''Reward:''' A helicopter tour of Fiji and a private beach picnic with fried chicken, fried potato wedges, cornbread, soft drinks, and chocolate chip cookies<br />'''Winners:''' {{tribehl3|savu|Purple Team}} ({{tribehl4|tovuto|Devin Way}}, {{tribehl4|tovuto|Eric Macksoud}}, {{tribehl4|tovuto|Lewis Kelly}}, {{tribehl4|tovuto|Mike Pinsky}}, and {{tribehl4|tovuto|Thien An Nguyen}})
|-|Immunity=
'''Challenge:''' ''[[Invertigo]]''<br />The castaways are going to use small handholds to secure themselves on a steep ramp suspended over water. At regular intervals, they'll go to smaller handholds, making it more difficult. If a castaway drops, they are out. The last person left standing wins immunity.<br />'''Winner:''' {{tribehl4|tovuto|Carter Krull}}
</tabber>

===Final Words===
{{Confessional|none|Flipped the coin and got sent packing. Ugh. In a way, it's such a disappointment to the game I played. Isolation on Exile for three days. The challenges, the blindsides. But on the other hand, you go out with a bang. Came here to play, I put my all forward, so, luck of the Irish ran out.|Lewis Kelly|Lewis|S51 lewis bw.png}}

==Trivia==
===Secret Scene===
*'''Schoolyard Pick:''' See how the Schoolyard Pick during the Reward Challenge went down.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G77pmFS7d8s</ref><ref>https://www.cbs.com/shows/video/ALVE01M7X8P5XNEN6V1NTH6NSKGZ8T/</ref>
*'''Bonding During Helicopter Reward:''' "We're all a bit mad in the head out here" 🤪<ref>https://www.instagram.com/survivorcbs/reel/Df-kkdpBSQb/</ref>
===Behind the Scenes===
* According to [[Lewis Kelly|Lewis]], when he initially flipped the coin, it landed on fire (which he called), but since it landed outside the landing mat, he had to flip it again. The second flip landed on the mat (which aired in the episode), but it came up on "water", eliminating Lewis without a vote.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jogmEqoHkww&t=511s</ref>
===Other===
*  The title of the episode was said by [[Eric Macksoud]] describing the [[Load the Ark, Two by Two|previous episode]]'s [[Tribal Council]].
*  This episode marks the first time a player fails with the [[Do or Die (twist)|Do or Die]] twist and is eliminated from the game as a result.
*  Events of the Do or Die coin flip on {{Ep|5010}} (specifically, [[Rick Devens]] being the one to flip the coin and being successful) were mentioned at Tribal Council during this episode. As the episode aired on April 29, 2026, and the season started filming on April 18, 2026 (with this tribal council taking place on May 4, 2026)<ref><nowiki>https://truedorktimes.com/s51/calendar.htm</nowiki></ref>, this seemingly indirectly confirms a speculated fan theory that the players were given an advance screening of the remaining unaired episodes from {{S2|50}} before the game started.
